branding.cobranded: A PSA & Blue & White Finance Game

level1.title: The Little Saver
level1.subtitle: Ages 6–8
level1.description: Learn to save and spend wisely at the makolet!
level1.intro: Welcome! You can earn shekalim by helping out around the house. Do chores, get paid, then head to the makolet — but choose wisely! Candy is yummy but it's gone fast. Save up for something bigger!

level2.title: The School Year Budget
level2.subtitle: Ages 9–11
level2.description: Manage your weekly pocket money through the school year.
level2.intro: You get weekly pocket money from your parents. But there are tiyulim, school supplies, and Purim is coming! Can you budget wisely?

level3.title: The Part-Time Worker
level3.subtitle: Ages 12–14
level3.description: Earn your own money and learn to manage it.
level3.intro: You've got your first job! Whether it's babysitting, tutoring, or delivering — this money is yours to manage. Plan for yom tov weeks when you can't work.

level4.title: The Road to Independence
level4.subtitle: Ages 15–17
level4.description: Manage a bank account, invest, and prepare for the future.
level4.intro: You're almost independent! Open a bank account, learn about investing, and plan for your gap year or army prep. Big decisions start now.

shopping.cantAfford: You don't have enough shekalim for this!
shopping.shabbatClosed: The makolet is closed for Shabbat. Plan your shopping for tomorrow!
shopping.yomTovClosed: The makolet is closed for Yom Tov.
shopping.cantAffordAnything: You only have ₪{{balance}} left — not enough to buy anything this week!
shopping.holdAndWait: Hold my money — skip to next week

budget.overspent: You've overspent! You need to cut back.
budget.wellDone: Great budgeting! You stayed within your means.

maaser.title: Maaser (Tzedakah)
maaser.explanation: Many Jewish families give 10% of their income to tzedakah. Would you like to include this in your budget?

consequences.tiyulMissed: Oh no! You didn't save enough for the tiyul deposit. Your spot was given to someone else.
consequences.giftCantBuy: Your friend's birthday is today, but you spent all your money on snacks. You can't buy a gift.
consequences.toyOutOfStock: You waited too long to save up — the toy you wanted is out of stock!
consequences.noSnacks: It's Shabbat and you forgot to buy snacks before! No treats this week.
consequences.cantAffordSupplies: School supplies are due, but you spent your money on wants. Now you need to ask your parents for help.
consequences.reducedIncome: It's a yom tov week — no work means less money this month. Did you plan ahead?
